items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: I got Wurline from Dave or what you call him at the... Frank. ... he used to fix me the cards from me.

ctx.x: Your father died when you were young, too.

Yeah, when I was young. He wasn't a good father, though. And my mother was good. And I wanted to show you all, though. I got a record from New Orleans Country Club. I played all of that stuff. I got Southern Yacht. Wonderful records. I got records from Wurline. I got Wurline from Dave or what you call him at the... Frank. Frank. Nice letter. Now, he was the man who used to write around the time when I wanted to call it, like David and Sears would open. I'd have nice cards printed, you see. Well, he used to fix me…
Did that have your picture on the band, that card or anything?
